map.光子动量与能量：动量 p = h ÷ λ，h 为普朗克常数、λ 为波长；光子能量: Photon momentum and energy: momentum p = h / lambda, where h is Planck's constant and lambda is the wavelength; photon energy E = hc / lambda; wavenumber = 1 / lambda; shorter wavelength gives larger momentum and energy, used in Compton scattering and radiation-pressure calculations.
map.光子静质量为零但具动量。: A photon has zero rest mass but carries momentum.
map.光镊/光帆受力。: Force on optical tweezers / solar sails.
map.全反射时动量变化 2p，可累计产生可测推力。: At total reflection the momentum change is 2p, accumulating into a measurable thrust.
map.静质量为零，但有动量 p=E/c=h/λ，由能量-动量关系给出。: Rest mass is zero, but it has momentum p = E/c = h/lambda, given by the energy-momentum relation.
map.辐射压多大？: How large is the radiation pressure?
map.P_rad=I/c（吸收）/2I/c（反射），地面阳光约 4.7μPa。: P_rad = I/c (absorption) / 2I/c (reflection), ground sunlight about 4.7 mu Pa.
